name: Strength and Shape: Postpartum Foundations
description: Three full-body days (A, B, C) for fat loss and a lean, toned look after a C-section with diastasis recti, with joint-sparing choices for palindromic RA. Strength work in paired sets keeps the pace up and holds on to muscle while diet does the fat loss; a short low-impact finisher and daily steps add to it. Hit the top of the range on every set, cleanly, two weeks running to move up. Get a pelvic health physio check first.
author: Fearne Hub

record_sections.label: Breathe and connect (2 min, every session)
options: 360 breathing lying on back, 5 slow breaths
Exhale, gently lift pelvic floor and draw lower belly in, 5 reps
3 glute bridges practising exhale on effort

record_sections.label: Warm-up (5 to 7 min)
options: March on the spot or brisk walk, 2 min
Gentle wrist circles, no weight on hands
One easy set of the first exercise

record_sections.label: Joint check
options: Flare: skipped exercises that load that joint

record_sections.label: Core check
options: Heaviness, leaking or scar pain: stopped and noted

record_sections.label: Low-impact finisher (6 to 10 min)
options: Step-up intervals: 30s brisk step-ups on a low step, 30s easy march, x8
Band circuit: 40s band punches with a march, 20s easy, x8
Squat to calf raise, band row, march: 40s each, 20s rest, 3 rounds
Skipped: flare, poor sleep or feeling run down

chains.label: Squat
chains.sub: Control and depth first, then load

exercises.name: Sit-to-stand from bench
exercises.note: Stand up without rocking, sit down slowly. Knees follow the toes. Add a folded mat on the bench if it is too low.

exercises.name: Box squat to bench, slow lower
exercises.note: 3 seconds down, light touch on the bench, stand. Chest tall, weight through the whole foot.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat to bench height
exercises.note: Tap and go, do not sit down.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat, full comfortable depth
exercises.note: Only as deep as the back stays neutral and heels stay down.

exercises.name: Goblet squat, light dumbbell
exercises.note: Around 4 to 6kg held at the chest. Exhale as you stand.

exercises.name: Goblet squat, moderate dumbbell
exercises.note: Around 8 to 12kg.

exercises.name: Goblet squat, heavier dumbbell
exercises.note: 12kg plus. From here keep adding 2kg once you hit the top of the range twice.

chains.label: Push-up
chains.sub: Incline first, on the rack bar or push-up bars so wrists stay straight

exercises.name: Wall push-up
exercises.note: Body in one straight line, ribs down. Exhale as you push away.

exercises.name: Incline push-up, rack bar at chest height
exercises.note: Grip the barbell so wrists stay straight. Elbows about 45 degrees from the body.

exercises.name: Incline push-up, rack bar at hip height
Incline push-up, rack bar at mid-thigh height
Incline push-up, rack bar at knee height
Push-up negatives on push-up bars
exercises.note: From toes, lower over 3 to 5 seconds, then knees down to come back up. Stop if the midline domes.

exercises.name: Full push-up on push-up bars, higher reps

chains.label: Ring row
chains.sub: Rings let the wrists turn freely; lower the body angle to progress

exercises.name: Seated band row
exercises.note: Band round the feet. Squeeze shoulder blades back and down, no shrugging.

exercises.name: Ring row, almost standing
exercises.note: Body rigid like a plank, pull the rings to the lower ribs, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Ring row, rings at hip height, knees bent
Ring row, rings at hip height, legs straight

chains.label: Dead bug path
chains.sub: Deep core rebuild. Stop the set if the midline domes

exercises.name: Heel slides
exercises.note: Reps are each side. Exhale as the heel slides away; low back stays gently on the floor.

exercises.name: Tabletop toe taps
exercises.note: Each side. Knees over hips, lower one foot to tap, exhale.

exercises.name: Dead bug, arms only
exercises.note: Each side. Legs hold tabletop while arms reach overhead in turn.

exercises.name: Dead bug, legs only
exercises.note: Each side.

exercises.name: Dead bug, opposite arm and leg
exercises.note: Each side. Slow, ribs stay down.

exercises.name: Dead bug, opposite arm and leg, leg straighter
exercises.note: Each side.

exercises.name: Dead bug with band pull-down
exercises.note: Each side. Band anchored overhead on the rack, hold it pulled to the hips while the legs move.

chains.label: Loaded carry
chains.sub: Walk tall with dumbbells: whole-body work that is kind to the core

exercises.name: Farmer's carry, light dumbbells
exercises.note: Around 4 to 6kg each hand. Tall posture, ribs down, steady breathing, short quick steps. Put them down if hands or wrists ache.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry, moderate dumbbells
exercises.note: Around 8 to 10kg each hand.

exercises.name: Suitcase carry, one dumbbell
exercises.note: Seconds are each side. Do not lean towards or away from the weight.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry, heavier dumbbells
exercises.note: 12kg plus each hand. Keep adding 2kg once top of range twice.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.note: Exhale and lift, squeeze glutes at the top, ribs down. Do not arch the low back.

exercises.name: Banded glute bridge
exercises.note: Band just above the knees, push knees gently out against it.

exercises.name: Hip thrust, shoulders on bench
exercises.note: Bench just below the shoulder blades, chin tucked, shins vertical at the top.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.note: Reps are each side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
exercises.note: Pad the dumbbell on the hips. Start around 8 to 10kg, add 2kg once top of range twice.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.note: Olympic bar with a pad. Start with the empty bar and add small plates over time.

exercises.name: Hip hinge with broomstick
exercises.note: Stick touches head, upper back and tailbone the whole time. Push hips back, soft knees.

exercises.name: Band good morning
exercises.note: Band under the feet and behind the neck. Hinge, then drive hips forward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift, light
exercises.note: Around 4 to 6kg each hand. Slide down the thighs, stop when the hips stop moving back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift, moderate
exercises.note: Around 8 to 12kg each hand.

exercises.name: Supported single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.note: Reps are each side. One hand on the rack for balance.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift with dumbbell
exercises.note: Reps are each side.

exercises.name: Kneeling band lat pulldown
exercises.note: Band over the rack's pull-up bar. Pull elbows down to the ribs, shoulders away from ears.

exercises.name: Supported hang, feet on bench
exercises.note: Relaxed grip, shoulders gently engaged. Let go if hands or wrists ache.

exercises.name: Scapular pull-ups
exercises.note: From a hang, pull shoulders down without bending the arms, then relax.

exercises.name: Flexed-arm hang
exercises.note: Step up from the bench to chin over bar and hold.

exercises.name: Negative pull-up
exercises.note: Step up to the top, lower over 3 to 5 seconds.

exercises.name: Seated band overhead press
exercises.note: Band under the bench or feet, palms facing each other. Ribs down, do not lean back.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell press, neutral grip
exercises.note: Start around 2 to 4kg each hand.

exercises.name: Standing dumbbell press, neutral grip
exercises.note: Squeeze glutes so the low back does not arch.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling single-arm dumbbell press
exercises.note: Reps are each side.

exercises.name: Standing dumbbell press, heavier
exercises.note: Add 1 to 2kg each time you hit the top of the range twice.

chains.label: Side and anti-rotation
chains.sub: Waist and trunk control without crunching

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.note: Reps are each side. Hands on push-up bars or fists to spare the wrists. Hips stay level.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling Pallof press
exercises.note: Reps are each side. Band anchored to the rack at chest height. Press out, resist the twist, exhale.

exercises.name: Standing Pallof press
exercises.note: Reps are each side.

exercises.name: Side plank from knees, on forearm
exercises.note: Each side. Hips pushed forward, straight line from knee to head.

exercises.name: Side plank from feet, on forearm
exercises.note: Each side.

exercises.name: Side plank from feet, top leg lifted
exercises.note: Each side.

chains.label: Split squat
chains.sub: Single leg, logged left and right

exercises.name: Split squat holding the rack, short range
exercises.note: Long stance, torso tall, lower a few inches and stand.

exercises.name: Split squat holding the rack, full range
exercises.note: Back knee lowers towards the floor, front knee tracks over the toes.

exercises.name: Step-up onto low step
exercises.note: Push through the whole front foot, control the way down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
exercises.note: Start around 4 to 6kg each hand.

exercises.name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat, holding the rack
exercises.note: Back foot on the bench. A big glute and thigh builder.

chains.label: Chest press
chains.sub: Loads the chest without bending the wrists back

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press, light, neutral grip
exercises.note: Lie on the mat, knees bent. Palms facing, elbows about 45 degrees, pause elbows on the floor. Start around 4 to 6kg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press, moderate
exercises.note: Around 8 to 10kg each hand.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press, neutral grip
exercises.note: Same grip on the bench, feet flat, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press, heavier
exercises.note: Add 1 to 2kg once top of range twice.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
exercises.note: Arms straight at chest height, squeeze shoulder blades together, no shrugging.

exercises.name: Band face pull
exercises.note: Band anchored to the rack at head height. Pull towards the eyes, elbows high.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row, light
exercises.note: Reps are each side. Hand and knee on the bench, back flat, pull to the hip.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row, moderate
exercises.note: Reps are each side.

chains.label: Plank path
chains.sub: On forearms to spare the wrists. Stop if the midline domes

exercises.name: Incline forearm plank on bench
exercises.note: Ribs down, glutes squeezed, breathe steadily throughout.

exercises.name: Forearm plank, slow alternating leg lifts
Hollow hold, knees bent
exercises.note: Only once the physio is happy with the abdominal gap. Low back stays on the floor.
